It has no checksum field, as the other MLXUI-authored manifests have none: there is no catflow source manifest to inherit one from and the field is documentary. engine is `mlx-align` (the issue's name for this runner). tasks is exactly [Align]: the model times a transcript, it does not transcribe. settings declares the row's only setting, lang= (the 11 codes Transcribe already uses; a missing value means English), matching AlignRowRequest which refuses any other key or language by name. resources.disk_gb is browser.json's downloadSizeGB (1.28) and resources.ram_gb is its provisional ramGB 1.91 (weights x 1.5); the maintainers set the measured figure after their own run, and the `.align` row in ModelLoadProfile is FA-7's measured booking.
